solutionSql:
SELECT id,
       CASE
         WHEN weight_kg IS NULL THEN 'unweighed'
         WHEN weight_kg >= 1000 THEN 'heavy'
         ELSE 'light'
       END AS weight_label
FROM shipments
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 40
ORDER BY id;
notes: The three bands are stated explicitly. The CASE tests for NULL first, so a missing weight can never fall through to light.
